content.title: Aethlon Medical announces pricing of $4.5M common stock, warrant offering
content.summary: Aethlon Medical (AEMD) announced the pricing of a public offering of an aggregate of 5M shares of its common stock and warrants to purchase up to 5M shares of common stock at a combined public offering price of 90c per share and accompanying warrant. The warrants will have an exercise price of 90c per share, will be exercisable immediately upon issuance and will expire on the fifth anniversary of the original issuance date. The closing of the offering is expected to occur on or about September 5
